title: Charlie Turner's Arcadians, and the union pulling him off
summary: Thomas worked with Charlie Turner's Arcadians at the Arcadia Ballroom, with Bobby Stark and Emmett Matthews, until the New York union pulled him off for lacking a card.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: See, in those days you've got to get around so people know you're in town. So a fellow by name of Charlie Turner, a fat man had a group (something about around the world) ...
Yes, I went to work with Charlie Turner's Arcadians.
At the Arcadia. Right here at 50th you know.
Arcadia Ballroom, 52nd, 53rd right in there. So I stayed there for a while and then the union pulled me off of that job.
You've got to have three months thing you've got to do which is protection, for the union people here.
Who was in Charlie Turner's band then, anybody famous?
Yeah. Let me see, Bobby Stark. Do you remember Bobby Stark. Bobby Stark went back to Chick Webb. Emmett Matthews was in front of the band
Drums. Yes because this is where Fats got some of these people.
That was his band. And these things are hard to remember, I don't want to miss anybody. Looked like the name had gotten around a little bit, you know.
